name: stage2_band_coverage_census_v1
purpose: Census the locally available 2000-2999 nt validation material and decide whether the Stage 2 gate's sparse-band requirement can be resolved from local data at family level and at clan level. Addresses V13 prioritized item 3.
what_this_is_not: A census of existing artifacts. It runs no inference, produces no accuracy measurement, changes no selection, and by itself satisfies none of the gate requirements.

sources.also_supplies_note: The primary family_clan_map does not cover every family in the candidate pool. Clan assignments are merged from both pinned sources, with provenance recorded per family and any disagreement raised as an error.

selected_complete_reference.note: Already in the frozen validation selection.

fixed_family_cap.note: A usable structure reference exists; rejected only by the per-family cap.

prior_exposure_overlap.note: Overlaps prior training exposure; ineligible as independent validation regardless of reference support.

unsupported_reference.note: No usable structure reference could be derived.

eligibility_rule: A candidate is eligible for band expansion when it lies in the band, its decision marks it reference_supported, and it is not exposed. Eligibility is about availability, not about accuracy.

independence_rule.baseline: The in-scope records of the frozen selection, that is the selected_complete_reference records under 3000 nt.
independence_rule.new_family: An eligible band record whose family is absent from the in-scope selected baseline.
independence_rule.new_clan: An eligible band record whose clan is absent from the in-scope selected baseline. Clan must come from the pinned clan sources; a family with no local clan assignment is reported as clan_unresolved and must never be counted as a new clan.
independence_rule.unresolved_visibility_rule: Every family appearing in the band must be reported as resolved or clan_unresolved, whether or not it is eligible. A family that is ineligible must not become invisible, because an unresolved or blocked clan is itself a finding.
independence_rule.cap_warning: Raising the per-family cap adds records, not independent evidence. Records from a family or clan already represented are pseudo-replicates for the purposes of the gate's family-and-clan-separated requirement, and the census must report family and clan counts, not only record counts.

requirement_rule: Status is assigned from existing verified artifacts only. The census may report a status but may not mark any requirement satisfied on the strength of the census itself.
no_claim_permitted: No accuracy, structure-quality or expression claim follows from a census of availability.
Counting eligible records does not make them validated, and does not establish that expanding the selection would improve or preserve measured accuracy.
The reference records available in this band are computational Rfam-consensus references, not experimental structures, so they cannot by themselves satisfy a native-control comparison.
No per-family cap, selection, model default or gate requirement is changed by this census.
No Stage 2 requirement is satisfied by this census.
